points.quote: Each document is a Yjs `Y.Doc` that holds the BlockSuite block tree.
It applies the others to the `Y.Doc` with `applyUpdate(doc, update, NBSTORE_ORIGIN)`. The editor re-renders from the Yjs doc
It is persisted as binary Yjs data in two forms: a merged snapshot and incremental updates.
Desktop (Electron) uses `SqliteDocStorage`, backed by a native SQLite module. Web and mobile use `IndexedDBDocStorage`.

`sync/doc/` creates one `DocSyncPeer` per remote. Each peer compares clocks and pushes or pulls updates between the local storage and the remote storage. ... Local-only workspaces have no remote, so they never sync.
